title: Build identity: support Git's reftable ref backend (currently reported as a fixed "unknown" source state)
outcome: Follow-up to w-ab6cc520ffb4 (health build identity), filed by Termal::Fable2 at Architect1's request (Sol-c593 mailbox 1a9f6a77 #275, 2026-10-19). w-ab6c's build.rs captures the build commit from the loose-ref and packed-refs files (HEAD, the pointed ref and packed-refs, with a bounded existing-ref-parent trigger). A repository using Git's reftable backend has no such files; w-ab6c detects that and reports a fixed unknown boundary, documented rather than supported. This item adds reftable support: resolve HEAD and the current ref from the reftable stack, using build.rs rerun triggers on the reftable directory, so a reftable repository reports the true commit, with the same no-unconditional-rerun guarantee.
acceptance: For a repository using the reftable backend, /api/health buildIdentity reports the correct full build commit and a clean, dirty or unknown sourceState, with build.rs rerunning only when the reftable stack or index changes; an isolated fixture proves two no-change builds do not rerun the script.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact input with an independent Codex plus Claude review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
